title: Automatic installation is offered
appearsWhen: You run nan claude in an interactive terminal and Claude Code cannot be found on PATH or at an executable path you supplied.
result: nan-harness pauses before launch, shows the official installer command, and asks for confirmation. Press y to install and continue, or press Enter to leave the system unchanged.
terminalOutput:
Claude Code was not found. Install the latest official release now?
Official installer: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
Install Claude Code [y/N]:

title: DeepSeek Harness requires a newer Node.js
appearsWhen: You run nan dsh while the active Node.js version is older than the minimum required by DeepSeek Harness.
result: nan-harness does not start the harness and shows commands for activating a compatible Node.js version.

message.summary: DeepSeek Harness requires Node.js >= 22.19.0, but detected Node.js v20.19.4.

actions.title: Recommended fix with nvm:
actions.detail: If nvm is unavailable, install Node.js 22.19.0 or newer with fnm, Volta, asdf, or the official Node.js installer.

title: Required Node.js runtime is missing
appearsWhen: You run a Node.js-based harness, such as nan qwen, but the node executable is not available on PATH.
result: nan-harness stops before installation or launch and explains how to install and activate Node.js.

message.summary: Qwen Code requires Node.js, but the node executable was not found on PATH.

title: npm is unavailable
appearsWhen: nan-harness needs npm to install a missing harness, such as OpenCode, but npm is not available on PATH.
result: nan-harness does not run the installer and shows how to activate a Node.js installation that includes npm.

message.summary: OpenCode uses npm for its official installation, but npm was not found on PATH.

actions.title: Activate a Node.js installation that includes npm:

title: User declined installation
appearsWhen: A harness is missing, nan-harness offers its official installer, and you decline the confirmation prompt.
result: Nothing is installed or changed. nan-harness exits and shows the command to try again later.

message.summary: Claude Code was not installed because the official installation was declined.

actions.title: Run the command again when you are ready:

title: Installation needs a terminal
appearsWhen: A harness is missing during a non-interactive run, such as CI or redirected input, where nan-harness cannot ask for installation consent.
result: nan-harness refuses to install software without consent and explains how to install interactively or supply an executable.

message.summary: Claude Code was not found and nan-harness cannot request installation confirmation in a non-interactive session.

actions.title: Install the harness interactively or provide its executable:

title: Official installer could not be downloaded
appearsWhen: You approve an installation, but the official installer cannot be downloaded because the request fails or times out.
result: nan-harness stops the installation, shows a nan-harness error code, and offers an anonymous report with your consent.

message.summary: the Claude Code installer download failed with exit code 28

title: Official installer returned an error
appearsWhen: The official harness installer starts but exits unsuccessfully, for example when npm returns a non-zero exit code.
result: nan-harness stops before launching the harness and offers an anonymous error report with your consent.

message.summary: the DeepSeek Harness installer command npm failed with exit code 1

title: Installed executable is not visible
appearsWhen: An installer reports success, but nan-harness still cannot find the new harness executable on PATH.
result: nan-harness stops and suggests opening a new terminal or supplying the executable path. It treats this as setup guidance.

message.summary: Claude Code was installed, but its executable is not visible on PATH.

actions.title: Open a new terminal or provide the installed path:

title: Harness startup check failed
appearsWhen: The harness executable appears after installation, but nan-harness's isolated startup check cannot run it successfully.
result: nan-harness treats the installation as unsuccessful, shows an error code, and offers a report with your consent.

message.summary: DeepSeek Harness was installed, but its isolated startup check failed.

title: NaN API key is missing
appearsWhen: You launch any harness without a saved or exported NaN API key in a session where nan-harness cannot ask you to enter one.
result: nan-harness stops before contacting the provider and shows the interactive and environment-based login options.

message.summary: A NaN API key is required and cannot be requested in a non-interactive session.

actions.title: Save a key interactively or provide it for this process:

title: NaN rejected the API key
appearsWhen: nan-harness verifies or uses the configured API key and the provider rejects that credential.
result: nan-harness stops the request and guides you through replacing the saved key. It does not classify invalid credentials as a nan-harness defect.

message.summary: NaN rejected the configured API key.

title: NaN API timed out
appearsWhen: A harness is running through NaN, but a provider request does not complete within the bridge timeout.
result: nan-harness aborts the request, shows a bridge error code, and offers an anonymous report with your consent.

message.summary: the request to NaN timed out

actions.title: Retry after checking the provider connection:

title: NaN returned an invalid response
appearsWhen: The provider returns a payload that the nan-harness bridge cannot parse or translate into the protocol expected by the harness.
result: nan-harness stops that response from crossing the bridge and offers an anonymous report with your consent.

message.summary: NaN returned a response that could not be translated for the harness

title: Requested model is unavailable
appearsWhen: You select a model that is not included in the model catalog available to the configured NaN account.
result: nan-harness stops before using the unavailable model and points you to account and model diagnostics.

message.summary: qwen3.6 is not available for the configured NaN account.

actions.title: Inspect the models available to this key:

title: Compatibility metadata is temporarily unavailable
appearsWhen: nan-harness's scheduled compatibility refresh cannot reach or validate the remote compatibility feed.
result: nan-harness continues with cached or embedded compatibility data and shows a warning without requesting a report.

message.summary: compatibility metadata refresh failed; continuing with cached or embedded values

title: Harness process could not start
appearsWhen: nan-harness has prepared a valid launch plan and found the executable, but the operating system cannot start the harness process.
result: nan-harness stops the launch, suggests local diagnostics, and offers an anonymous report with your consent.

message.summary: the harness process could not be started

title: Tool request could not cross the bridge
appearsWhen: A running harness sends a tool definition or tool request that the nan-harness bridge cannot translate safely.
result: nan-harness rejects the incompatible translation instead of forwarding malformed data and offers a report with your consent.

message.summary: the harness sent a tool schema that nan-harness could not translate
